# Conformance Check for Wiki Bundles

This module provides functionality to check the conformance of markdown files in a wiki bundle against the OKF v0.2 specifications. It validates that the frontmatter of non-reserved files is correct and enforces specific requirements for reserved filenames like 'index.md' and 'log.md'.
